datasets.title: Myanmar Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 5.3 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 44% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 2 years ( Last edited 2 months ago ) and 36% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset represents approximately 5.3 million mapped buildings with 36% of features added or updated within the last 6 months, providing a spatial inventory of building structures for disaster risk assessment in Myanmar.
